meta.name: cross-reference
meta.description: Cross-reference ENCODE data with PubMed, bioRxiv, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Targets, GTEx, ClinVar, GWAS Catalog, gnomAD, Ensembl, and other scientific databases. Use when the user wants to find publications, preprints, or clinical trials related to ENCODE experiments, chain ENCODE data with other scientific MCP servers, or build translational pipelines from genomic data to clinical application.

copy.tagline: 关联ENCODE数据与多个科学数据库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果做基因组数据与文献、临床试验的交叉分析
copy.tagline_en: Cross-reference ENCODE data with scientific databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you cross-analyze genomic data with publications and clinical trials

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能帮你把 ENCODE 基因组数据与 PubMed、ClinicalTrials.gov、Open Targets 等数据库交叉查询，找到相关文献、临床试验、药物靶点或变异注释。
howto.when: 当你提到“交叉引用”、“关联”或“连接”ENCODE 数据与 PubMed、临床试验等数据库时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个 ENCODE 实验对应的原始论文。
say.note: Claude 会提取 PMID 并获取文章元数据。

say.text: 这个基因靶点有没有相关的临床试验？
把 ENCODE 的增强子区域与 GTEx 表达数据关联起来。
say.note: Claude 会注释最近基因并查询组织表达。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can cross-reference ENCODE data with PubMed, ClinicalTrials.gov, Open Targets, GTEx, and other databases to find publications, trials, drug targets, or variant annotations.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you mention 'cross-reference', 'link', or 'connect' ENCODE data with PubMed, clinical trials, or other databases.

say_en.text: Find the original paper for this ENCODE experiment.
say_en.note: Claude extracts PMIDs and fetches article metadata.

say_en.text: Are there clinical trials for this gene target?
say_en.note: Claude searches ClinicalTrials.gov and links results.

say_en.text: Cross-reference ENCODE enhancers with GTEx expression.
say_en.note: Claude annotates nearest genes and queries tissue expression.
